column1: # Authored complete WDBC stores only; no game assets. Ground uses source flat-height dispatch/body.
# Scope excludes TerrainInfo/VMAP liquid selection, terrain interpolation, admission and movement.
# LiquidType format: niii; AreaTable format: niiiixxxxxissssssssxixxxi
# Stores 0..3: bit0 adds LiquidType ID 0; bit1 adds AreaTable ID 0; other absent IDs really are absent.
# DBC strings are hex 0061006200630064006500660067006800; every row below is every raw WDBC word.
# liquid_row columns: store Id LiquidId Type SpellId; area_row columns: store fields[0..24].
# Both cell tables are row-major 16*16. MLIQ is flat level +0, offX=offY=0, width=height=128.
# Profile columns: id store global_area global_entry global_flags area_table type_table
# Queries select tiles 32,32 and 31,33. *_bits are hexadecimal binary32; other columns are decimal.
# Cell edges use (32-(tile+cell/16))*SIZE_OF_GRIDS, adjacent world floats and cell +/- 1/1024.
# NO_WATER preserves all sentinels; wants_data=0 preserves sentinels even with nonzero status.
